description: PRODUCTION deployment for the first real test (real_signal/REAL_TEST_PLAN.md). certificate, password, signup_signed, signup_kyber and signup_one_time come from the registered account (lss-provision export-account ... deployment-hints.json). handshake is EMPTY until measured (real_signal/measure_handshake.py production, with the owner's go-ahead): circuit production refuses nothing for it, but a strict session would refuse every tls-open-handshake kernel. signup_ciphertext 240 and signup_hints 1 are guesses for a Signal-Android first message (CLIENT_FINGERPRINT.md (e)): measure from the first refused signup. Not yet listed by circuit_inventory: the libsignal-profile seal kernels (signal-seal-official, bundle-seal 80k-1), so --strict cannot be used with SIGNAL_CLIENT_PROFILE=libsignal yet.
